grain.$description: A tile of grain (an SVG feTurbulence, D-52), 160 px square, as a CSS image — a string token: the whole url() is the value. Grey specks (a little darker than mid grey) whose opacity follows the noise, so they darken a light backdrop and lighten a dark one alike, about as strongly; the strength is the rect's opacity in the SVG.
